title: Chess: draw conditions — repetition, 50-move, insufficient material
description: Threefold repetition: track position hashes, draw when same position occurs 3 times. Fifty-move rule: track halfmove clock (reset on pawn move or capture), draw at 100 half-moves. Insufficient material: K vs K, K+B vs K, K+N vs K, K+B vs K+B (same color bishops).
close_reason: Fifty-move rule, threefold repetition, insufficient material draw detection. 9 tests.
